subject: District-Wide Strategic Plan
overview: The MPS Communications Subcommittee reviewed the draft district-wide strategic plan and established a timeline for spring community engagement. The subcommittee also received an update on spring 2021 middle school lottery and transition practices.

items.title: District-Wide Strategic Plan
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed the draft strategic plan and set a schedule to host community roundtables and surveys in spring 2021 before finalizing the plan.

items.title: Middle School Orientation Practices
items.summary: Administration outlined transition plans for rising middle schoolers, including a March lottery, virtual or in-person open houses, parent information sessions, and an orientation cookout.
